title: Industry Report | Jul 2022 TikTok Shop Monthly — ID Live GMV ~$99M
summary: Jul’22 TikTok Shop monthly (UTen live estimates; ID/UK/TH/VN). Indonesia remains the scale leader on live GMV and orders; UK leads on field GMV; Thailand and Vietnam keep climbing off a June multimillion base. Personal care & beauty and women’s apparel dominate category mix
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Monthly · August 12, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

Jul’22 TikTok Shop monthly (UTen live estimates; ID/UK/TH/VN). Indonesia remains the scale leader on live GMV and orders; UK leads on field GMV; Thailand and Vietnam keep climbing off a June multimillion base. Personal care & beauty and women’s apparel dominate category mix across markets; SKINTIFIC-class beauty SKUs recur in ID top-10.

Key figures from CN source (attach full country/SKU/creator tables on ingest): 2022年7月，印尼总GMV达9914.53万美金（折合人民币6.62亿元），相比6月的1.02亿美金（折合人民币6.72亿元），有所下降 / 英国板块中，7月总GMV达1135.62万美金（折合人民币0.76亿元），是本次4个国家中GMV总量排名最后一位的国家，订单量达77.38万单，而场均GMV则为最高，达到14.47美金 / 泰国板块中，7月总GMV达4036.96万美金（折合人民币2.7亿元），订单量达1091.08万单，场均GMV达3.69美金，在4个国家中排在最后 / 越南板块中，7月总GMV达3225.02万美金（折合人民币2.15亿元），订单量达701.29万单，场均GMV达4.59美金

— END —
